name: vault-launch-smoke
comment: Vault execution Slice 8: the assembled app exposes the Open Media control in the taskbar dock, and the launch-state surface is present and idle at boot. The native picker / OS drag-drop / Ctrl+O are inherently outside the first-root-window model (human-witnessed by design, ledger: secondary windows/OS surfaces invisible) — this scenario proves what the bridge CAN reach. Isolated tagged session on a unique pipe; never the daily app.

steps.label: the smoke session answers, drive gated on
one visible window, isolated data root
the boot splash has left the screen
the launch-state surface exists and is idle at boot
settle the dock open (a real round-trip, no sleep)
the Open Media control renders, visible + actionable + unclipped
